title: Artificial Intelligence Safety Act
committees: Senate Executive Committee — AI and Social Media Subcommittee
last_action: Re-referred to the Senate Assignments Committee under Rule 3-9(a).
summary: Would create a liability safe harbor for frontier-model developers that publish safety and security protocols and transparency reports, with alternative compliance available through qualifying European Union requirements or a federal agreement. The state requirements would sunset if overlapping federal requirements take effect.
committee_dynamics: The bill reached the AI and Social Media Subcommittee but was re-referred after repeated deadline extensions. Its interoperability and federal-sunset provisions distinguish it from Illinois's enacted Public Act 104-0538.
advance_rationale: The measure missed committee and third-reading deadlines and returned to Assignments, although the General Assembly remains in the same biennial session.
